Read input: origen_091845.v · Open raw
module origen_091845(
    input CLOCK_50,
    input ps2_key_pressed,
    input [7:0] ps2_key_data,
    input [8:0] xplay, yplay,
    input [2:0] colorplay,
    input [8:0] xstart, ystart,
    input [2:0] colorstart,
    input [8:0] xswipe, yswipe,
    input [2:0] colorswipe,
    input hit1, hit2,
    input swipedone,
    input enable, active,
    output reg [8:0] x, y,
    output reg [2:0] color,
    output reg startstate, playstate, swipestate
);

    // State encoding
    localparam START = 3'b000;
    localparam PLAY = 3'b001;
    localparam SWIPE = 3'b010;

    reg [2:0] CS, NS;

    // State transition logic
    always @(*) begin
        case(CS)
            START: begin
                if (startstate && ps2_key_pressed && ps2_key_data == 8'h5A)
                    NS = SWIPE;
                else
                    NS = START;
            end
            PLAY: NS = PLAY;
            SWIPE: begin
                if (swipedone) begin
                    if (playstate)
                        NS = START;
                    else if (startstate)
                        NS = PLAY;
                    else
                        NS = SWIPE;
                end
                else
                    NS = SWIPE;
            end
            default: NS = START;
        endcase
    end

    // State register
    always @(posedge CLOCK_50) begin
        if (!enable)
            CS <= START;
        else
            CS <= NS;
    end

    // Output logic
    always @(posedge CLOCK_50) begin
        case(CS)
            START: begin
                if (ps2_key_pressed && ps2_key_data == 8'h76)
                    startstate <= 1'b1;
                if (startstate) begin
                    x <= xstart;
                    y <= ystart;
                    color <= colorstart;
                end
                playstate <= 1'b0;
                swipestate <= 1'b0;
            end
            PLAY: begin
                x <= xplay;
                y <= yplay;
                color <= colorplay;
                startstate <= 1'b0;
                playstate <= 1'b1;
                swipestate <= 1'b0;
            end
            SWIPE: begin
                if (!swipedone) begin
                    x <= xswipe;
                    y <= yswipe;
                    color <= colorswipe;
                end
                startstate <= 1'b0;
                playstate <= 1'b0;
                swipestate <= 1'b1;
            end
        endcase
    end

endmodule
